description:
Spec: draft-atwood-jmap-cid-00 (urn:ietf:params:jmap:cid).

Goal: stand up a new workspace crate jmap-cid-types containing the CID capability and the sha256 typed shape. CID is independent of chat — it's a Blob/FileNode extension that any JMAP deployment can advertise. Decision (Mark, 2026-05-12): mint a dedicated crate rather than fold into jmap-base-client.

## Acceptance

- New directory crate-jmap-cid-types/ at the workspace root
- Cargo.toml declares: name = "jmap-cid-types", version = "0.1.0", inherits license/edition/repository from workspace
- Dependencies: jmap-types (workspace), serde, serde_json — no async deps (type crate posture per AGENTS.md)
- src/lib.rs: forbid(unsafe_code), declares modules + module-level doc-comment with spec cite
- AGENTS.md (~30 lines): identifies this as a type crate, points at draft-atwood-jmap-cid-00, notes the no-async / no-jmap-server-dep posture
- PLAN.md: scope, target structure (sha256 typed string with the spec's 64-hex-char ABNF validation), reference implementations to mirror (jmap-types Id newtype style)
- README.md: short summary + spec reference
- Workspace Cargo.toml `members` list updated to include "crate-jmap-cid-types"
- Workspace AGENTS.md crate map (Crate Map table + Dependency Tree section) gets a row for jmap-cid-types
- cargo check --workspace passes with the empty skeleton

## Out of scope

- Defining the sha256 typed shape itself (D.2)
- Wiring sha256 into Blob upload response (D.3)
- Capability advertisement detection (D.4)
title: Layer D: Create jmap-cid-types crate skeleton
